name: Guiding Starknife
text:
This +1 striking returning starknife is made of dark blue metal overlaid with smoky flecks of fused quartz. When you Cast a Spell and deal damage, your next attack before the end of your turn with this starknife ignores standard and lesser cover.

Activate—Points of Light r (concentrate, spirit)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You successfully Strike a creature with a thrown Strike with the guiding starknife

---
Effect The guiding starknife's blades detach, form into darts of starlight, and deal 4 piercing,1d4 spirit damage to the creature you just hit. This damage increases to 6 piercing,1d4 spirit with a greater striking rune and to 8 piercing,1d4 spirit with a major striking rune. The guiding starknife then re-forms and returns to your hand. Until the start of your next turn, the damaged creature is outlined with soft light and can't gain the effects of concealment.
